    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Qualifiers: January 8th - 21th, 2024
      • Round Robin
      • All matches are Ft3
      • Top 2 teams from each group advance to Main Event
    • Main Event: January 26th - 28th, 2024
      • Double elimination bracket
      • First round are Ft2
      • All subsequent rounds are Ft3
